name: Pasifik Holding A.S.
summary: Pasifik Holding A.S., through its subsidiaries, engages in providing diversified range of services in various sectors. The company operates in multiple sectors, such as real estate and construction, international logistics, technology, and energy and mining. Its real estate services include real estate investment and development. It offers railway transportation and solutions in international transportation, logistics, and terminal services.
